Score a run against ground truth

Source: R/truth.R
pf_evaluate.Rd

Score a run against ground truth

Usage

pf_evaluate(
  run,
  truth = NULL,
  population = NULL,
  min_confidence = c("medium", "high", "low")
)

Arguments

run

A run result: pf_match_grants()$result or a frame with an id column (grant_id or .id), a tier, and an EIN column (ein, overall_ein or ein9).

truth

The ground-truth table, or a path to it. Defaults to data-dev/PF-TRUTH.csv.

population

Optional fingerprint to enforce. When supplied and it disagrees with the truth table, this errors rather than scoring.

min_confidence

Drop truth rows weaker than this. "medium" (the default) keeps web- and reference-based labels and the stratified inferences; "high" keeps only web-confirmed EINs.

Value

An object of class pf_eval: a list of summary (one row) and detail (per-case).

What it can and cannot measure

Recall is measured against the truth rows that carry a correct_ein. Precision on the YES mass is not measurable from a truth table built out of cells the pipeline failed on — that needs a random stratified sample. What is measurable without one is false clears: truth rows asserting no organisation exists at all (an individual payee, a government body, a payee with no exemption of its own) must never be YES, so any that are are unambiguous false accepts.
